findings.claim: Machine-local prerequisite skills are referenced as documented in a file that is not present in the repository.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria 1.1 requires every skill named in the prompt to resolve locally or be a documented prerequisite; the agent says "Sources are listed in `docs/agent-team.md`", but the supplied file_tree under `./docs` contains only `images` and `performance-tuning.md`, and the diff does not add `docs/agent-team.md`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `docs/agent-team.md` documenting the machine-local prerequisite skills, or change the agent prompts to point to an existing documented prerequisite location.
